sources.title: Interim 2024-based housing-led population projections
sources.verified_claim: The interim 2024-based projections use preliminary 2026 SHLAA housing assumptions and provide borough and ward scenarios; they are modelled projections and do not allocate or validate a sample parcel.

sources.title: Housing-led population projections
sources.verified_claim: GLA states housing-led projections reconcile population growth with assumed housing supply and notes a new 2024-based release is planned; current projections remain scenario outputs rather than parcel forecasts.

sources.title: GLA population projection service
sources.verified_claim: The GLA service accepts alternative housing scenarios and documents substitution of SHLAA-based assumptions where local inputs are missing; model defaults are retained as a limitation.

sources.title: London Industrial Land Supply Study
sources.verified_claim: The study provides a London-wide industrial land baseline and SIL analysis and explicitly describes itself as high-level evidence and a starting point for further local work; it is not parcel determination.

sources.title: Residential approvals dashboard
sources.verified_claim: The dashboard reports PLD residential approvals but warns applicant/authority-supplied data is not quality-checked on receipt and can be revised; counts are contextual until core data is reviewed.

sources.title: Residential starts dashboard
sources.verified_claim: The dashboard reports residential commencements and warns totals and underlying PLD data can change through periodic quality reviews; it is not parcel-specific construction evidence.

sources.title: Residential completions dashboard
sources.verified_claim: The dashboard reports PLD residential completions and explicitly retains data-quality caveats and borough reporting limitations; completion aggregates are not proof for a sample parcel.

sources.title: Residential pipeline dashboard
sources.verified_claim: The pipeline dashboard calculates year-end residential pipeline from PLD data but says it remains in development, is subject to quality review and totals will change; pipeline context is not exact parcel delivery.
